purpose: Freeze the current evidence-only data state before integrating externally compiled dataset research. This receipt closes local deterministic preparation; it does not admit sources or authorize acquisition or training.

completed_scope.boundary: Exact counts, tokenizer/index reconciliation, cross-source exact and normalized diagnostics, length bands and retained-bank bounds are recorded. Eligible supply remains zero until gates close.
HQ/control inventory, overlap, extraction follow-up and review panels are recorded. Source-use, cutoff, family graph and eligible yield remain open.
Cohort reading, origin recovery and benchmark/family holds are recorded. Quota-blocked origins, notices, semantic usefulness and eligible yield remain open.
Inventory, overlap, configuration diagnostics and arithmetic triage are recorded. One likely source transcription error is held; broader correctness, source-use, family graph and supply remain open.
SFT format/context, tool-aware rehearsal and bounded RL inventory are recorded. Source rights, correctness, outcome verification, long-tail coverage and stage eligibility remain open.
OpenMath, FineMath/InfiWebMath and SmolTalk reviews are pinned. Viewer responses are not revision-proof and no candidate is admitted.
Research contrasts, controls, budgets and gates are fixed. No packet authorizes acquisition, training or production mixture selection.

source_use.decision_needed: Named rights/notice/applicability decision per selected source and transformation.

family_partition.decision_needed: Frozen exact/near-duplicate/source-family graph with disjoint training, development and final evaluation families.

correctness.decision_needed: Independent checks for worked math, generated solutions, code exercises, SFT outcomes and reward references.

finite_supply.decision_needed: Accepted unique tokens/rows, exclusions, storage/acquisition cost and repetition policy per declared bank.

runtime.decision_needed: GH200 single/four-worker qualification and common comparison horizon.

external_research_intake.admission_rule: Research notes update hypotheses and candidate metadata only. A source enters a study arm only after all five gates close in a revised source-readiness matrix and a finite manifest is hash-bound.
do_not_infer: quality from publisher scores or model-card claims
correctness from format validity or answer agreement
source rights from host URLs or public visibility
training value from a confounded architecture, schedule or token-horizon comparison

launch_boundary: This closeout is an evidence handoff. It does not authorize corpus acquisition, source substitution, training, repetition, GPU spending or publication claims.
next_action: Execute the bounded downstream audit protocol after source/parent gates close: structural SFT audit, stratified outcome/tool review, then fixed-policy verifier feasibility.

external_research.changes_made: Added structured synthesis and design requirements; no source admission, mixture percentage or GPU allocation changed.
